name: Karan Geta
description: Karan Geta — a WooCommerce store theme for a geta (wooden sandal) workshop on a hot-spring street, laid out as a hanging scroll you read from top to bottom. A formal white top header carries the shop name, the Book a fitting button, account and cart; the main menu always opens from a Menu button as a full-screen shinbashi turquoise overlay (set vertically in Chinese and Japanese). Shinbashi turquoise (#59B9C6) is the main colour: the hero field, the menu overlay, the scroll spine, every page head and the footer strip are turquoise fields with sumi blue-black text on pale turquoise washi. The hero is a vertical banner: a tall woodblock print of the hot-spring street hangs like a shop banner from a wooden rod, beside the shop line (a vertical line in Chinese and Japanese); a cut-out pair of geta (transparent WebP) steps off the banner and over the hero's bottom edge. Five workshop steps hang on a turquoise spine, and a full-bleed woodblock band of the paulownia yard carries a turquoise card that a second pair of geta breaks out of. Every picture is a full woodblock-print illustration. Yuji Boku for display, Jost for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-5 (tategaki-vertical-scroll, vertical-banner hero, overlay nav, full-illustration, woodblock, shinbashi #59B9C6, Yuji Boku + Jost, geta sandals in fashion-beauty). A formal white top header: the shop name on the left; the Book a fitting button, account, cart and a Menu button on the right; the main menu always opens as a full-screen turquoise overlay (set vertically in Chinese and Japanese). Tategaki vertical scroll: the home page reads top to bottom like a hanging scroll; five workshop steps hang on a turquoise spine, and in Chinese and Japanese the hero, the scroll head, the page heads and the menu overlay carry vertical lines (English, French and German stay horizontal). Vertical-banner hero: a tall woodblock print of the hot-spring street hangs like a shop banner from a wooden rod on a full turquoise field. Full illustration: every picture is a full woodblock-print raster illustration (no photos); the paulownia band is one illustration edge to edge. Break-frame: the cut-out pair of geta (transparent WebP) steps off the foot of the hanging street banner and over the turquoise hero's bottom edge into the workshop board; a second cut-out pair breaks out of the turquoise card and over the top edge of the full-bleed paulownia band; the geta also break over the bottom edge of every page head. Images generated with Grok Build. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: sumi blue-black #10272B on shinbashi turquoise #59B9C6 6.8:1 (all text on the hero field, the menu overlay, page heads, the board lead card, the scroll numbers, the band card and the footer strip); ink on pale turquoise washi #F1F8F9 14.5:1, on white 15.6:1 and on steam mist #DCEFF2 13.1:1; deep teal #1D5F6A on paper 6.7:1, on white 7.2:1 and on mist 6.1:1 (links, prices, labels; white on deep 7.2:1); slate teal #3E585C on paper 7.1:1 and on white 7.6:1 (secondary text); white on ink 15.6:1 (buttons, chips, footer) and pale turquoise #BEE5EB on ink 11.6:1; cypress wood #7A5233 on paper 6.3:1 (small marks); white on turquoise only 2.3:1 and deep teal on turquoise 3.2:1, never used for text.

fonts.role: display: hero and section headings, the shop name, menu items, product names (Regular 400; a Latin subset and a subset of the Japanese sample text)
display for Traditional Chinese pages (SemiBold 600, subset to the characters of the zh-TW sample text; a mincho close to the brush weight of Yuji Boku, never a Japanese font)

summary.zh-TW: 新橋水藍色的手工木屐工房：版面像一幅直式捲軸，主視覺是垂掛的木刻版畫溫泉街旗幟，去背木屐破框而出；含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A shinbashi-turquoise geta workshop store read like a hanging scroll, with a woodblock street banner and cut-out geta breaking out.
summary.ja: 新橋色の下駄工房のお店。掛け軸のように縦に読む構成、のぼりのような木版画の湯の町、枠を破る切り抜きの下駄。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Une boutique d’atelier de geta turquoise, lue comme un rouleau, avec une bannière de rue en estampe et des geta détourées.
summary.de: Ein türkiser Geta-Werkstattladen wie eine Hängerolle: Holzschnitt-Straßenbanner und freigestellte Geta, die ausbrechen.
